review_text: The camera quality is amazing and the battery lasts all day. Dynamic Island is super useful for tracking deliveries and timers.
Really good camera and performance. Wish it had a USB-C fast charger in the box. The 128GB base storage feels limiting in 2026.
Coming from Samsung I was skeptical but the iOS ecosystem is just seamless. FaceTime with family is so much better. Battery easily lasts a full day.
It is a good phone but honestly not that different from iPhone 14. The camera bump is nice but not worth upgrading.
As a hobbyist photographer the 48MP camera is incredible. Night mode shots are stunning. Only issue is the weight.
This phone feels incredibly premium. The Action button is customizable and useful. ProMotion display is buttery smooth.
The 5x zoom on the Pro Max is mind-blowing but even the Pro at 3x is exceptional. Video recording in ProRes is professional grade.
Performance is incredible for gaming and productivity. However it does get warm during extended gaming sessions. Battery is great though.
The AI features are incredible. Circle to Search is something I use daily. Call translation works perfectly for my business calls.
The display is the best I have seen on any phone. Brightness outdoors is exceptional. Camera is very good but not quite iPhone level in low light.
For the price you get an amazing phone. One UI 6.1 is smooth and feature-rich. Battery lasts a full day with heavy use.
The phone is good but Samsung promised a lot with AI and some features feel gimmicky. Camera is good but the processing is too aggressive.
The 200MP camera is insane. Moon shots are actually real now. S Pen is perfect for note-taking in meetings. Best phone I have ever used.
S Pen for signing documents and taking notes during calls. Galaxy AI transcribes my meetings. Battery easily lasts two days.
It is the best Android phone no doubt. But at 1.3 lakh it is hard to justify when the S24 does 80 percent of what this does.
OnePlus finally delivered again. The Hasselblad cameras are legit now. 100W charging means 1 to 100 in 25 minutes. Insane value.
The Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 handles everything I throw at it. Display is gorgeous at 120Hz. Only complaint is OxygenOS has too many ads now.
You get flagship specs at a reasonable price. Camera is much improved over OnePlus 11. Battery and charging are best in class.
I use these in the office and on flights. Noise cancellation is on another level. Sound quality is warm and detailed. 30 hour battery is real.
Sound quality and ANC are best in class. But the headband does not fold anymore which makes them less portable. Carrying case is huge.
Coming from cheap headphones these are life changing. The multipoint connection lets me switch between laptop and phone seamlessly.
Seamless switching between my iPhone iPad and Mac. Noise cancellation is shockingly good for earbuds. Adaptive transparency is magic.
Sound quality is very good and ANC is excellent. But 25k for earbuds is a lot. The USB-C case with Find My speaker is a nice touch.
I use this for note-taking and reading textbooks. M2 chip handles everything smoothly. Apple Pencil support makes it a real productivity tool.
Performance is incredible for the price. Only wish it had ProMotion display. Stage Manager on the external display is useful.
Finally a premium Android tablet that competes with iPad. S Pen included is great value. DeX mode makes it almost a laptop replacement.
The AMOLED display is stunning for watching movies. Speakers are loud and clear. S Pen is a nice bonus. One UI for tablets has improved a lot.
